_comment: Tenancy-guard RATCHET BASELINE — the (route::table) pairs that violate invariant (A)
today. This is DEBT WITH A NAME, not an exemption: an exemption in
scripts/tenancy-guard-exemptions.ts is a claim that the route is correct by design,
a baseline entry is an admission that it is not and has not been fixed yet.
The list may only SHRINK. The guard treats a baselined violation as a warning, any
violation NOT in this list as a hard failure, and a baseline entry that no longer
violates as a hard failure too ('stale baseline — remove this line'). So GUC-wrapping
a route forces the line out of this file in the same commit.
Seeded 2026-09-06 from the security pen-test handoff (Wave-2 item 17) when the gate
was re-armed: 31 pairs across 22 routes. Never add a line without GUC-wrapping
